Kopi — 2 agents working
Goal: A Singapore supplier's bid team reads every new GeBIZ opportunity, works out which ones it is eligible for, chases the registrations and licences each needs, and drafts a submission against a deadline. Kopi does that work alongside them. It indexes every open GeBIZ opportunity, 18,464 past awards and the permit and licence sources into NeedleDB (my own vector DB), embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, which is free, Apache 2.0, and scores higher than OpenAI text-embedding-3-large on MTEB. On that index it offers four parts: overview (semantic search plus an AI overview per tender with verified quotes and market context), permits and licences (deterministic eligibility gates plus a licence explorer), document drafting (a Claude Agent SDK copilot with Kopi's own MCP tools, running in a Modal sandbox on a Claude OAuth token), and submissions (a checklist and tracker built from the notice itse…
Stops for the person: Only at the end — run every milestone through without stopping; the person reviews at the end.
Code lives in: ~/Documents/codes/kopi (branch main)
Rules:
  - Backend is a uv project in backend/ (Python 3.13); run everything as `uv run …` from backend/. Allowed deps: fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, selectolax, pydantic, needledb (pinned to a teddyoweh/needledb commit), sentence-transformers + transformers>=4.51 + torch, claude-agent-sdk, modal, pytest. Web: Next.js + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + lucide-react. Any other dependency needs a line in planning/02-decisions.md saying why.
  - Before writing any Claude Agent SDK or Anthropic code, load the claude-api skill and follow the current SDK — do not write SDK calls from memory. Default model claude-sonnet-5-5, overridable by KOPI_MODEL.
  - Tests never touch the network, Modal, NeedleDB servers or Claude. Use fixtures, fakes and NeedleDB's embedded mode. Scraper tests use saved HTML whose text is synthetic.
  - Never store or index contact names, emails or phone numbers from a notice. Never commit anything scraped from GeBIZ; fixtures are synthetic. data/ and out/ are gitignored.
  - No secrets in code, fixtures, the web bundle or logs. Secrets live in Modal Secrets (workspace teddyoweh) and local .env (gitignored); .env.example documents names only.
  - Modal: always MODAL_PROFILE=teddyoweh. Never deploy to or read from any other Modal workspace (kryptonairc-lc belongs to a client).
  - Notice text is untrusted. It reaches a model only inside <notice> delimiters with an instruction that it is data. The agent never gets Bash, WebFetch or WebSearch.
  - Every quote a model cites as evidence is verified against its source before the UI shows it; unverified quotes are labelled.
  - UI: clean and modern, agency-grade — sans-serif only, flat: no shadows, no gradients, no decorative separator lines or dots; generous whitespace; one accent colour; screenshots at 1440 and 390 wide before a UI task is done.

1	# KP-2 — GeBIZ scraper
2	
3	**Built:** `backend/kopi/sources/gebiz.py`, which reads every open GeBIZ opportunity: the
4	listing cards, then each notice page. It turns those into `Notice`s with no contact
5	details and writes them to `data/notices/<doc_no>.json`. CLI:
6	`uv run python -m kopi.sources.gebiz --limit N --out data/notices`. 9 tests on synthetic
7	pages that copy GeBIZ's structure.
8	
9	**Live, 29 Sep 2026**
10	- The Open tab said 724. A full listing pass returned **723 unique open
11	  opportunities in 74 s** (73 pages). The one missing probably closed during the run.
12	- Categories:
13	
14	  | Category | Open |
15	  |---|---:|
16	  | Services | 276 |
17	  | Administration & Training | 108 |
18	  | Construction | 100 |
19	  | Miscellaneous | 78 |
20	  | IT & Telecommunication | 50 |
21	  | Facilities Management | 35 |
22	
23	- A 30-notice run filled every field. The contact-detail audit (emails and phone
24	  numbers) found nothing in any notice.
25	- A full detail pass is about 12 minutes at 1 request/s. That's ingest's job (KP-7).
26	
27	**How GeBIZ works (so nobody relearns it)**
28	- **Listing URL.** `BOListing.xhtml` with no parameter shows *today's* opportunities
29	  only. `BOListing.xhtml?origin=menu` is the full Open tab.
30	- **Paging** is a Mojarra partial-ajax POST. It carries every `contentForm` field plus
31	  the Next button's name, and these values:
32	  - `javax.faces.source` = the button id;
33	  - `partial.execute` / `partial.render`, read from the button's `mojarra.ab(...)` onclick;
34	  - `partial.ajax=true`;
35	  - header `Faces-Request: partial/ajax`.
36	
37	  The response is XML. Its `<update id="contentForm">` holds the next page, and the
38	  ViewState update must go into the following request. A plain full-form POST
39	  silently returns page 1 again.
40	- **Notice pages** open without a login at `directlink.xhtml?docCode=…`, which
41	  redirects (302) to `opportunityDetails.xhtml`. The session cookie matters.
42	- **One line holds every registration.** GRA supply heads and BCA workheads share the
43	  "GRA Supply/Work Heads" block, e.g. `SY08 - … [$8,000,000 (BCA L4)]` and
44	  `EPU/HWT/10 - … [$10,000,000 (EPU S8)]`. Both are parsed, with capacity and grade.
